detail.longDescription: A new version of Bloom (1.17.0) has been released. Highlights: - Automatic settings backup to a folder you choose. - Search Settings and flip switches right in the results. - Optional line numbers in the editor. - %id placeholder gives captured headings unique IDs. - One attachment folder for the whole vault. - Agenda: only missed deadlines are overdue; late starts get a Carried over section. - Faster editors and capture in large vaults. - Bug fixes. Get the latest version from GitHub Releases, F-Droid or Google Play by clicking on one of the install badges at the top of the readme here: https:// github.com/rrajath/bloom Detailed list of changes explained here in this blogpost: https:// bloom.rrajath.com/blog/bloom-1 -17-0 # bloom # emacs # orgmode # productivity # apps
